leads.title: Pennington v. Government - Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals
leads.documents: Only reported sodomy case in Guam in early 1950s; victory for defendant on procedural grounds that trial court lacked authority to try without jury
leads.detail: Cited in History section as 'Pennington v. Government'; no URL visible in text

leads.title: U.S. District Court for the District of Guam ruling by Chief Judge Frances Tydingco-Gatewood - June 5, 2015
leads.documents: Ruled Guam's prohibition on same-sex couples marrying unconstitutional, leading to issuance of licenses four days later
leads.detail: Dated June 5, 2015 in Recognition section; cites Latta v. Otter; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Latta v. Otter - Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals
leads.documents: Precedent striking down identical same-sex marriage bans in Idaho and Nevada, cited as basis for Guam marriage ruling
leads.detail: Cited in Recognition section as 'Latta v. Otter'; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Guam Marriage Equality Act of 2015 - Legislature of Guam
leads.documents: Made Guam marriage laws gender-neutral after court decision; passed August 11, 2015
leads.detail: Cited as passed August 11, 2015; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Guam Criminal Code reform of 1978
leads.documents: Decriminalization of private, adult, consensual non-commercial homosexual acts; sodomy/fellatio/cunnilingus ban from 1933 Naval Governor penal code no longer enforced
leads.detail: Cited in History section as 1978 reform, replacing 1933 code; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Bill 102-33 - Guam Legislature
leads.documents: Unanimously passed August 2015 ban on discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity or expression in employment, including government employees
leads.detail: Cited as Bill 102-33, August 2015; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Matthew Shepard and James Byrd Jr. Hate Crimes Prevention Act (2009) - U.S. federal law
leads.documents: Provides federal hate crime coverage on sexual orientation and gender identity applicable in Guam since 2009
leads.detail: Cited in Discrimination protections section as 2009 federal law; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Guam Department of Public Health and Social Services announcement - May 2017
leads.documents: Policy to enter names of both spouses on birth certificates of children with same-sex parents; recognizes non-genetic, non-gestational married parent via donor insemination
leads.detail: Dated May 2017 in Adoption section; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Office of Vital Statistics / Motor Vehicle Division gender-change procedure and Senator Fernando Esteves bill (2018)
leads.documents: Current rule requires physician sworn statement of sex reassignment surgery for amended birth certificate and driver's license; 2018 reform bill to allow judicial permission plus psychologist/social worker/therapist letter without surgery failed 6-7 on Dec 17, 2018 after postponement Dec 13, 2018
leads.detail: Introduced May 2018 by Senator Fernando Esteves; Legislature vote details in Transgender rights section; no URL visible in text

leads.title: University of Guam poll - April 2015
leads.documents: Living conditions / societal acceptance data: 55% of Guam residents in favor of same-sex marriage, 29% opposed, 16% undecided
leads.detail: Conducted by students from University of Guam, April 2015; no URL visible in text
